acceptance: The measurement method and figures are recorded so the problem can be re-measured.
context: Filed 2026-11-20 from the adversarial review of the scale-factor and TPC-DI remediation work (PRs #4298-#4385 and benchbox-site #178-#210).
description:
## Problem
Against one baseline, the median normalized ratio differs by GitHub runner class from about 1.04 to about 1.23, and the same head has scored 1.01 and 1.29 on different runners. Across 55 runs the coefficient of variation of the normalized ratio is 0.085 with the CPU-calibration normalizer. Within one runner class, shared-test slowdown is 0.7 to 0.9 points a day. Most false blocks come from runner class, not baseline age. Dividing by collection time lowers the variation to 0.026 but lets a pull request influence its own divisor and loosens with suite growth, so it was rejected.

## Change
No fix is proposed. Keep the data (scripts and inputs are not committed; record the method here) and bring options to the owner if false blocks recur.

## Decision gates
Any normalizer or threshold change is an owner decision (the owner decided on 2026-11-17: no threshold change).

## Verification rubric
Pass: the method to reproduce the per-class medians and the variation figure from CI artifacts is written on this item.

## Guardrails
- Any limit, default, threshold or label text is shown to the owner before it is committed.
- The implementer never resolves review threads on its own pull request; the reviewer or the owner does.
- No polling loop around `make pr-arm`, no `--no-verify`, and no stand-in review unless the owner names the PR and head unprompted.
- Heavy work runs only through `make heavy-run` or a lock-taking entry point.
- Status reports state only what merged and what was verified, with the evidence.
